_comment: M24 P9 hard-execute roster (kill-line, NOT damage scaling). Seed curation from wiki (loop 87, Cowork). Threshold terms: raw = base + perLevel*(level-1) + perRank*(rank-1) + perStack*stacks + perAp*AP + perBonusAd*bonusAD + perLethality*lethality; PercentMaxHp multiplies raw by target maxHP, FlatHp is absolute. needsConfirm rows have approximate numbers pending BIN/M11 dynamic sourcing (Hard Rule #4). NON-executes deliberately excluded: Garen R / Mel P / Cho'Gath R (damage/scaling, folded into combo total).

rules.label: 징수의 총
rules.note: combo that leaves target below 5% maxHP executes

rules.label: 장로용 버프
rules.note: Elder Immolation, true dmg, ignores shields; threshold computed post-mitigation

rules.label: 파이크 R
rules.note: (loop 104 BIN-EXACT vs pyke.bin.json PykeR 'RDamage' ByCharLevelBreakpoints) L1Value=250 + mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter +40@L7 / +30@L10 / +20@L12 / +10@L17 -> exact per-level base table [250(L1)..550(L18)] (L6=250, L9=370). This REPLACES the loop-95 linear perLevel=17.647, which over-estimated the L6-9 ult window by up to +88HP (R opens at L6 but the real base is flat 250 through L6). +0.8 bonusAD (mStat=2/formula=2) + 1.5 lethality (mStat=29) unchanged, added on top of the table. needsConfirm REMOVED -- baseByLevel is the exact piecewise curve (no FormulaInterpreter needed).

rules.label: 우르곳 R
rules.note: (loop 95 BIN-confirmed vs urgot.bin.json 'RHealthThreshold'=25.0, all ranks) executes below exactly 25% max HP, rank-invariant.

rules.label: 드레이븐 R
rules.gateNote: threshold in HP equals current Adoration stack count (live value)
rules.note: Whirling Death executes at/below flatHp == Adoration stacks

rules.label: 아우솔 특이점 중심
rules.gateNote: center of Singularity only; stacks = Stardust

rules.label: 제리 P(일반샷)
rules.note: (loop 95 BIN-confirmed vs zeri.bin.json 'PassiveExecuteThreshold') = ByCharLevelInterpolation(70->160) + 0.20 AP. perLevel = (160-70)/17 = 5.294 -- the EXACT linear interpolation the BIN uses, not an approximation. CORRECTS the prior 5.918/170.6 (BIN endValue is 160 at L18, not 170.6).

rules.label: 스몰더 P
rules.gateNote: Dragon Practice tier 3 (StackTier3=225); target must be burning
rules.note: (loop 104 BIN-confirmed vs smolder.bin.json) SmolderQ DataValue Tier3_ExecuteThreshold = mMultiplier(0.01) x Tier3_ExecuteThresholdStart(6.5) = exactly 6.5% FIXED, no stack growth. The 'Tier3_Burn_Stack_Mult'(0.00005) that loop-95 suspected of growing the line is a BURN-damage coefficient (feeds the Tier3_Burn calc), NOT the execute threshold -- confirmed distinct. tier-3 gate StackTier3=225. needsConfirm REMOVED (base 0.065 is the exact value).
